messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SLO ALERT: realtime-streaming.p99 > 600ms in us-west-2 (sustained 3m). Triggered at 2026-03-17 14:05:11 UTC
sasha_sre: paging @tim_eng, @jules_prod — are we seeing errors or just latency?
tim_eng: joining… checking dashboards
tim_eng: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/realtime/streams?panelId=9 — p99 spike aligns with increased queue length
jules_prod: saw small uptick in kv-cache evictions ~14:03 — could be hot prefixes
maria_support: any customer impact? CS reports one enterprise seeing request timeouts
sasha_sre: ok route -> oncall checklist: 1) confirm impact 2) isolate infra vs model 3) mitigation
tim_eng: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n realtime | grep serving | wc -l` -> nodes healthy
tim_eng: `promql: increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])` shows spike on host pool-8
jules_prod: shifting canary routing to fallback-variant for ~10% traffic via rollout tool
sasha_sre: starting canary now :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Deploy event triggered by jules_prod (rollout-id r-9932) — 10% -> fallback-model
tim_eng: still seeing p95 elevated but p99 dropping slightly
maria_support: Customer A confirmed degraded UX but no data loss; CS escalating SLA alert
sasha_sre: good note — will open incident page and notify PagerDuty for engineering follow-up
tim_eng: possible hot-key causing KV contention, I'm going to evict targeted prefixes and increase cache size on pool-8
jules_prod: prepared rollback plan if latency worsens
sasha_sre: timeline: alert @14:05, canary -> 14:12, p99 down by 14:18 — continue monitoring, if p99 < 300ms for 10m we'll de-escalate
maria_support: logging customer touchpoints
tim_eng: updated runbook with commands used
oncall-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: realtime-streaming.p99 back under 300ms after mitigations at 14:20 UTC
sasha_sre: thanks team — file postmortem? assign to tim_eng + jules_prod
jules_prod: will start notes, include KV cache metrics and routing config
maria_support: I'll send customer update template
tim_eng: leaving follow-up tasks in incident tracker
